sets.name: Woodpecker Electro
sets.bonus_4pc_raw: Landing a critical hit on an enemy with a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> increases the equipper's ATK by 9% for 6s. The buff duration for different skills are calculated separately.

sets.name: Puffer Electro
sets.bonus_4pc_raw: <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> DMG increases by 20%. Launching an <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> increases the equipper's ATK by 15% for 12s.

sets.name: Shockstar Disco
sets.bonus_4pc_raw: <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attacks</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attacks</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counters</color> inflict 20% more Daze to the main target.

sets.name: Freedom Blues
sets.bonus_4pc_raw: When an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> hits an enemy, reduce the target's Anomaly Buildup RES to the equipper's Attribute by 20% for 8s. This effect does not stack with others of the same attribute.

sets.name: Hormone Punk
sets.bonus_4pc_raw: Upon becoming the active character in combat, the equipper's ATK increases by 25% for 10s. This effect can trigger once every 20s.

sets.name: Soul Rock
sets.bonus_4pc_raw: Upon receiving an enemy attack and losing HP, the equipper takes 40% less DMG for 2.5s. This effect can trigger once every 15s.

sets.name: Swing Jazz
sets.bonus_4pc_raw: Launching a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> increases all squad members' DMG by 15% for 12s. Passive effects of the same name do not stack.

sets.name: Chaos Jazz
sets.bonus_4pc_raw: <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> and <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color> increases by 15%. While off-field, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Attack</color> DMG increases by 20%. When switching on-field, this buff continues for 5s, and this continuation effect can trigger once every 7.5s.

sets.name: Proto Punk
sets.bonus_4pc_raw: When any squad member triggers a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Evasive Assist</color>, all squad members deal 15% increased DMG, lasting 10s. Passive effects of the same name do not stack.

sets.name: Inferno Metal
sets.bonus_4pc_raw: Upon hitting a <color=#FF5521>Burning</color> enemy, the equipper's CRIT Rate is increased by 28% for 8s.

sets.name: Chaotic Metal
sets.bonus_4pc_raw: The equipper's CRIT DMG increases by 20%. When any character in the squad triggers <color=#FE437E>Corruption</color> DMG, this effect further increases by 5.5% for 8s, stacking up to 6 times. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

sets.name: Thunder Metal
sets.bonus_4pc_raw: As long as an enemy in combat is <color=#2EB6FF>Shocked</color>, the equipper's ATK is increased by 28%.

sets.name: Polar Metal
sets.bonus_4pc_raw: Increase the DMG of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack</color> by 20%. When any squad member inflicts <color=#98EFF0>Freeze</color> or <color=#98EFF0>Shatter</color>, this effect increases by an additional 20% for 12s.

sets.name: Fanged Metal
sets.bonus_4pc_raw: Whenever a squad member inflicts <color=#F0D12B>Assault</color> on an enemy, the equipper deals 35% additional DMG to the target for 12s.

sets.name: Branch & Blade Song
sets.bonus_4pc_raw: When Anomaly Mastery exceeds or equals 115 points, the equipper's CRIT DMG increases by 30%. When any squad member applies <color=#98EFF0>Freeze</color> or triggers the <color=#98EFF0>Shatter</color> effect on an enemy, the equipper's CRIT Rate increases by 12%, lasting 15s.

sets.name: Astral Voice
sets.bonus_4pc_raw: Whenever any squad member enters the field using a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, all squad members gain 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Astral</color>, up to a maximum of 3 stacks, and lasting 15s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Each stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Astral</color> increases the DMG dealt by the character entering the field using a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> by 8%. Passive effects of the same name do not stack.

sets.name: Shadow Harmony
sets.bonus_2pc_raw: The DMG of <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershocks</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attacks</color> is increased by 15%.
sets.bonus_4pc_raw: Upon hitting an enemy with an <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack</color>, if the DMG dealt aligns with the equipper's attribute, the equipper gains 1 stack of a buff effect, at most once per use of a skill. For each stack, the equipper's ATK increases by 4%, and CRIT Rate increases by 4%. The effect can stack up to 3 times and lasts for 15s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

sets.name: Phaethon's Melody
sets.bonus_4pc_raw: When any squad member uses an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, the equipper's Anomaly Proficiency increases by 45 for 8s. If the character using the <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> is not the equipper, the equipper's <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color> is increased by 25%.

sets.name: Yunkui Tales
sets.bonus_4pc_raw: When using <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, CRIT Rate increases by 4%, stacking up to 3 times and lasting 15s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. When having 3 stacks of this effect, Sheer DMG increases by 10%.

sets.name: King of the Summit
sets.bonus_4pc_raw: When the equipper is a Stun character and uses an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, increases CRIT DMG of all squad members by 15%, and when the equipper's CRIT Rate is more than or equal to 50%, further increases CRIT DMG by 15%, lasting 15s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Passive effects of the same name do not stack.

sets.name: Dawn's Bloom
sets.bonus_4pc_raw: Increases <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> DMG by 20%. When equipped by an Attack character, using an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> will further increase <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> DMG by 20% for 25s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

sets.name: Moonlight Lullaby
sets.bonus_4pc_raw: When the equipper is a Support character and uses an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, the DMG dealt by all squad members increases by 18% for 25s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Passive effects of the same name do not stack.

sets.name: White Water Ballad
sets.bonus_4pc_raw: When the equipper is within any <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil</color>, their CRIT Rate increases by 10%. After leaving the <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil</color>, this buff remains for 15s. If the equipper is an <color=#FFFFFF>Attack</color> character, activating an <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil</color> or extending an <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil</color>'s duration increases their CRIT Rate by 10% and ATK by 10% for 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

sets.name: Shining Aria
sets.bonus_4pc_raw: When the equipper's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> hits an enemy, their Anomaly Proficiency increases by 36, lasting 8s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. When any enemy on the field is Stunned, the equipper's DMG increases by 25% for 18s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

sets.name: Bunny in Wonderland
sets.bonus_4pc_raw: When the equipper is a Defense character: When the equipper launches an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> or any squad member triggers a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Evasive Assist</color>, all squad members' DMG increases by 6%, stacking up to 3 times, lasting 25s. Stacks decay one at a time, and duration refreshes when gained or decayed. Passive effects of the same name do not stack.

effects_4pc.trigger_label: EX Special / Defensive Assist / Evasive Assist

sets.name: Notes From the Chained
sets.bonus_4pc_raw: When the equipper triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color>, their Anomaly Proficiency increases by 48 for 30s; repeated triggers reset the duration. When the equipper triggers a <color=#FFFFFF>Freeze</color> effect, their All-Attribute Anomaly DMG and <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color> DMG increase by 16% for 30s; repeated triggers reset the duration.

sets.name: Wuthering Salon
sets.bonus_4pc_raw: When the equipper uses an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, their Anomaly Proficiency increases by 25, stacking up to 2 times, and lasting 40s; repeated triggers reset the duration. When the equipper triggers <color=#A6C5FD>Windswept</color>, their DMG increases by 18% for 40s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

sets.name: The Sky Ablaze
sets.bonus_4pc_raw: When the equipper is an <color=#FE437E>Ether</color> attribute Agent, their CRIT DMG increases by 30%. When the equipper uses an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, their ATK increases by 10% for 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

sets.name: Feathered Fate
sets.bonus_4pc_raw:
When the equipper enters the battlefield or is switched in as the active character, they gain the following buff: Anomaly Proficiency increases by 50. If the equipper is a <color=#FFA9DD>Lumiflux</color> character, Attribute Anomaly DMG increases by 15%, lasting 15s.
This buff remains active while the equipper is off-field.

sets.name: Thorned Rose
sets.bonus_4pc_raw: The equipper's DMG increases by 15%. When the equipper's initial DEF is at least 1,000/1,800, CRIT Rate increases by 8/16%.
